name: Additive Food Business and Community Meals Direction
source: Food Business and Community Meals Implementation Handoff supplied by River Young in this conversation
status: Current additive product direction; planning only, no product implementation authorized
objective: Plan a private, traceable food-business foundation for packaged meatless refrigerated/frozen reheat meals, with later reviewed personal fulfillment, accounting, and optional community meals.
relationship: This direction and CREATION-001 are complementary. Neither handoff supersedes the other or replaces existing insurance, Sesh, commerce, content, Cloudflare, River OS, or development-agent work.
currentState: Commerce contains a digital-product catalog, Stripe checkout and verified-webhook boundaries, canonical orders, durable persistence, and digital fulfillment. These do not establish physical-food ordering or food-provider approval.

River OS provides a private workspace and CRM; principal identity, sessions, and Sesh ownership provide additional authorization patterns. Food staff roles and accounting are not established by these foundations.

The handoff reports training, cottage registration, and EIN obtained; these are user-supplied progress records, not newly verified agency evidence. Tax, banking, water, equipment, payment, operating policies, and partner readiness remain unresolved.

firstImplementationSlice.status: Proposed only; implementation requires a later bounded instruction
firstImplementationSlice.scope: Pure draft-domain types and validation for versioned food product/recipe information and explicit review evidence, without side effects or sales enablement
proposedInformation: Draft product and recipe version references, ingredients/component subingredients, declared allergens, preservation method, temperature-control classification, and historical label-review references.
Separate cottage eligibility, sales-tax classification, safety/process review, and payment/operational readiness evidence, including source and review date when supplied.
readinessSemantics: Unknown and pending are explicit valid states. Absent evidence stays unknown; an unanswered review stays pending.
Do not default to eligible, exempt, safe, approved, or ready. Structural validation is never agency approval, recipe validation, or permission to sell.
The draft domain grants no sellable state, checkout registration, dispatch authority, or production activation.
acceptanceCriteria: Pure validation preserves unknown/pending states, rejects malformed evidence without fabricating approvals, and leaves inputs unchanged.
Recipe/ingredient changes create distinct versions and require fresh label/allergen review without rewriting historical evidence.
No database, storage, provider, route, network, checkout, payment, publication, or fulfillment dependency exists in the slice.

externalReadinessGates: Verify recipe-specific cottage eligibility, preservation requirements, authoritative label wording, and current applicable gross-sales threshold before encoding rules or enabling sales.
Resolve product-specific tax treatment and applicable obligations using authoritative guidance and the pending Comptroller response; cold/frozen or cottage status never implies blanket exemption.
Retain training/registration evidence privately and verify applicable current requirements. Do not invent an LLC, DBA, agency approval, expiry, or bank account.

Establish safe-water evidence, suitable equipment, measured cooling/storage/transport capacity, package and reheating trials, recipes/costs, and operational traceability. Do not interpret unknown water analytes or units.

Treat the FDA cooling benchmark as proposed operational best practice, not an invented cottage permit. Do not introduce homeowners insurance or an unsupported city food permit as opening requirements.

Confirm food-business payment-provider support, banking, identity documentation, fees/refunds, service radius, slots, capacity, delivery charges, and cancellation/missed-meetup policies before activation.
Verify lawful personal delivery and required pre-payment disclosures; no assumed nationwide shipping, third-party courier authorization, or equivalence of prepaid home pickup.
Community hot-meal preparation/distribution requires a separately verified lawful arrangement; donating finished home TCS meals to a partner does not itself establish compliance.
Choose a partner and define business contribution percentage/basis before promises. Outside contributions require separate lawful/provider setup; no nonprofit or tax-deductibility claim.
futureScope: Reviewed small menu, inventory and slot reservations, manual outside-area approval before charging, hosted payment collection, verified payment before dispatch, personal fulfillment, and versioned labels.

Private batch/cooling, inventory, receipts, equipment, cash/payment/bank reconciliation and protected CPA exports; settlements and deposits must not duplicate sales, and separate businesses retain separate books.

Meal-information links, food videos through the shared content/media workflow, attribution, and the proposed 20-percent next-three-orders welcome offer only after terms and margin review; no implied recurring billing.

Partner-backed community records and reconciled public snapshots starting at zero; distinguish confirmed served meals, partner evidence, transfers, receipts, spending and commitments without double-counting.
Later reviewed anonymized education; no recipient identification, filming handoffs, required publicity/religious participation/purchase, or disclosure of private business evidence.
boundaries: No routes, schemas, migrations, persistence, checkout, Stripe changes, media rendering, public counters, livestreaming, food catalog entries, production data, provider activation, contact execution, or deployment.
Keep private operating addresses, EIN/bank information, receipts and agency evidence out of public/static content and planning examples.
Do not invent menu items, radius, prices, equipment purchases, partners, contribution basis, approval evidence, or launch date.
nextStep: Review a separately bounded pure draft-domain specification before implementation; operational and public capabilities remain later work.
launchIntent: Launch as River Young, individual sole proprietor, serving Big Spring and immediate surroundings through prepaid site orders and local personal delivery/meetup; radius and meetup locations remain undecided.

The chosen model seeks only products and sales methods with verified sales-tax exemption/favorable treatment; the exemption-only product model awaits authoritative confirmation. Sales-tax exemption does not remove income/self-employment tax obligations.
Creator implementation does not block food work. Community readiness applies only to community activation, not food-business launch.

A full accounting dashboard, paid advertising, advanced rewards, recipe publication and community fundraising are optional later capabilities, not prerequisites for an otherwise lawful launch with adequate interim records.
operationalAcceptance: Compute prices, tax, discounts and totals server-side; unknown tax status must not imply exemption. Hosted payment collection/tokenization stores no card numbers or CVC.

Verify webhook signatures and safely handle repeated/out-of-order events without duplicate orders, revenue or rewards. A success-page visit is not proof of payment; confirm server-side before dispatch and never dispatch cancelled or unconfirmed payments.

Reserve inventory, slots and coupon uses transactionally; concurrent requests cannot oversell capacity or duplicate/overconsume benefits. Outside-area trips require approved fee/window before charging.

Model partial refunds and exceptions, cancellations, rescheduling and missed meetups. Record handoff/transport controls and use consent-based communications without automatic marketing-text subscription.
Keep test/production data separate and secrets outside source control. Maintain protected exports, server-side permissions, backup and rollback practices when persistence is separately authorized.
labelAccountingCommunityRequirements: Preserve required physical and pre-payment label disclosures using current official wording and legible printing, including applicable preparation date and safe-handling text/font requirements; QR codes never replace disclosures.

The richer label standard includes full ingredients and purchased-component subingredients, clear Contains declaration, portion/net quantity where applicable, every-meal batch code, storage and tested reheating directions, River Young identity, registered identifier and website QR. Preserve historical recipe/label versions and complaint-to-order/batch traceability.
Monitor gross sales against a configurable, reviewed applicable annual limit; expenses do not reduce counted sales and the monitor is not a profit counter.

Distinguish sales, discounts, refunds, tax, delivery, fees, optional tips, settlements, cash/deposits, owner transfers, expenses and equipment. Trace expenses to dated receipts and business purpose; uncertain tax treatment goes to the CPA.

A dated CPA package includes reconciled transactions, reports with stated accounting basis, equipment, settlements/fees, sales-tax records, receipt index/files, owner transfers, community activity and unresolved questions. Check completeness before calling it CPA-ready; no autonomous tax filing or AI categorization treated as CPA approval.

First-order packages include QR/code cards for the chosen 20-percent next-three-orders offer after terms/margin review. Track one offer per customer, three actual qualifying redemptions, visible remaining uses, no unintended stacking, cancellation/refund restoration and originating-card/order attribution; prevent unlimited guest offers.

Business-funded giving precedes outside contributions. Define percentage/basis, refunds/discounts/tax/delivery treatment, transfer frequency and destination before promises; community gates apply to that program only.

Monthly public reporting uses period/cumulative totals, definitions, last reconciliation/publication date, reconciled funds/spending/remaining commitments and approved redacted evidence. Corrections are auditable; no fake totals or fabricated equivalents, and no borrowed campaign dollar-to-meal ratio or implied partnership.

Count confirmed meals rather than unique people unless independently evidenced, distinguish direct/partner channels and spending/distribution dates, and do not double-count transfers or meals. Donor names remain private unless opted in; recipient privacy and voluntary access remain firm.
